# llms.txt for Lottery Pattern Analyzer

> Lottery Pattern Analyzer is a free online tool for generating lottery numbers and analyzing number frequency patterns for Powerball, Mega Millions, and EuroMillions.

## Site Information
- Name: Lottery Pattern Analyzer
- URL: https://funnyscarry100.github.io/Powerball-Mega-Millions-EuroMillions/

## Main Pages
- Home: https://funnyscarry100.github.io/Powerball-Mega-Millions-EuroMillions/index.html
- Terms: https://funnyscarry100.github.io/Powerball-Mega-Millions-EuroMillions/terms.html
- Privacy: https://funnyscarry100.github.io/Powerball-Mega-Millions-EuroMillions/privacy.html
- About: https://funnyscarry100.github.io/Powerball-Mega-Millions-EuroMillions/about.html

## Core Features
- Lotto Number Generator (Pattern-Based + Balanced Set)
- Interactive Frequency Heatmap (Hot/Warm/Cool/Cold)
- Powerball, Mega Millions, EuroMillions presets
- Real-Time Statistics (odd/even ratio, high/low ratio, sum range)
